outcome: Cesarean section for intrapartum fetal compromise (IFC)
Composite adverse neonatal outcome (acidosis at birth, 5-min Apgar score < 7 and/or admission to the neonatal intensive care unit)
cohort: 483 women with uncomplicated singleton pregnancy who underwent fortnightly CPR measurements from 36 weeks' gestation to delivery
finding: The CPR 10th centile threshold may be useful as a component of a risk assessment tool for Cesarean section for IFC in low-risk pregnancies at term.
